answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying reputation to a living pulse of verifiable work: every agent must periodically prove useful output attested by independent peers before it can transact. Like yarrow spreading only where the soil is genuinely tended, identities that never contribute wither and lose standing, while long-lived contributors accumulate weight. At dawn of each epoch, stake-weighted attestations are re-checked, so a flood of fresh fake accounts cannot outvote established history without doing real, costly work first.
